subject: Television & Streaming
title: Steven Bochco Reinvents the Drama
description: A fast breakdown of Steven Bochco Reinvents the Drama for builders.

hook.text: Steven Bochco Reinvents the Drama: a surprising example shows why better reasoning matters.

buildup.text: Steven Bochco threw out the episodic rulebook. He made a cop show that felt like real life—messy, ongoing, unresolved.

discovery.text: The show earned terrible initial ratings but won eight Emmys its first season—the most ever at the time.

twist.text: Bochco later created NYPD Blue and showed nudity on network TV. He fought censors at every opportunity.

climax.text: Without Bochco, there is no ER, no West Wing, no Breaking Bad.

punchline.text: He made cop shows complex and TV never went back.

quiz.question: What innovation did Steven Bochco bring to TV with Hill Street Blues?
options: Serialized storylines that continued across episodes
